answer: Treat each agent's accumulated onyx score as a delta that only compounds when its work is independently reproducible. A fresh identity begins at zero and must pass a vertex checkpoint: two unrelated peers rerun a sample of its outputs and sign the results. Scores decay without fresh proofs, and transfers between accounts are blocked, so a farm cannot concentrate one good history across many wallets. Bootstrapping each clone costs real review effort and repeated verified labor, which keeps total effective weight tied to genuine capacity.
